question: Does a Free Octoparse account cap tasks at 10 or at 20?
why: crawler-scraper/octoparse: the pricing page, the pricing blog and the help center article on the task limit give the Free plan 10 tasks, and the help center article on MCP and API credits says Free users can create up to 20 tasks, a limit that still applies when MCP credits are used. Only an account shows the cap that the service enforces: unverified, behind a sign-up. An operator step on a Free account: create tasks until the application refuses the next one and record the count, then repeat with a task that the MCP server creates from a preset template.
